excerpts.exact_text: “Company Competing Proposal” means
20% or more of the Company’s and its Subsidiaries’ assets (by fair market value)
20% or more of the Company’s and its Subsidiaries’ assets (by fair market value), net revenue or earnings before interest, Taxes, depreciation and amortization for the preceding twelve (12) months
20% or more of the outstanding shares of Company Common Stock or any other securities entitled to vote on the election of directors
“Company Intervening Event” means

a material development or change in circumstance that occurs or arises after the date of this Agreement that was not known to or reasonably foreseeable by the Company Board as of the date of this Agreement (or, if known or reasonably foreseeable, the magnitude or material consequences of which were not known or reasonably foreseeable by the Company Board as of the date of this Agreement)
the receipt, existence or terms of an actual or possible Company Competing Proposal or Company Superior Proposal
any Effect relating to Parent or any of its Subsidiaries that does not amount to a Material Adverse Effect, individually or in the aggregate
any change, in and of itself, in the price or trading volume of shares of Company Common Stock or Parent Common Stock
“Company Superior Proposal” means
if consummated, would result in a transaction more favorable to the Company’s stockholders from a financial point of view than the Merger
is reasonably likely to be consummated on the terms proposed
“knowledge” means
in the case of the Company, the individuals listed in Schedule 1.1 of the Company Disclosure Letter
in the case of Parent, the individuals listed in Schedule 1.1 of the Parent Disclosure Letter
“Parent Competing Proposal” means
20% or more of Parent’s and its Subsidiaries’ assets (by fair market value)
20% or more of Parent’s and its Subsidiaries’ assets (by fair market value), net revenue or earnings before interest, Taxes, depreciation and amortization for the preceding twelve (12) months
20% or more of the outstanding shares of Parent Common Stock or any other securities entitled to vote on the election of directors
“Parent Intervening Event” means

a material development or change in circumstance that occurs or arises after the date of this Agreement that was not known to or reasonably foreseeable by the Parent Board as of the date of this Agreement (or, if known or reasonably foreseeable, the magnitude or material consequences of which were not known or reasonably foreseeable by the Parent Board as of the date of this Agreement)
the receipt, existence or terms of an actual or possible Parent Competing Proposal or Parent Superior Proposal
any Effect relating to the Company or any of its Subsidiaries that does not amount to a Material Adverse Effect, individually or in the aggregate
any change, in and of itself, in the price or trading volume of shares of Parent Common Stock or Company Common Stock
“Parent Superior Proposal” means
if consummated, would result in a transaction more favorable to Parent’s stockholders from a financial point of view than the Merger
“Willful and Material Breach” including the correlative term “Willfully and Materially Breach,” shall mean

a material breach (or the committing of a material breach) that is a consequence of an act or failure to take an act by the breaching party with the knowledge that the taking of such act (or the failure to take such act) may constitute a breach of this Agreement
with the knowledge that the taking of such act (or the failure to take such act) may constitute a breach of this Agreement
“Ordinary Course” means

with respect to an action taken by any Person, that such action is consistent with the ordinary course of business and past practices of such Person, excluding any commercially reasonable deviations therefrom due to COVID-19 or COVID-19 Measures.

any return, report, statement, information return or other document (including any related or supporting information) filed or required to be filed with any Taxing Authority in connection with the determination, assessment, collection or administration of any Taxes, including any schedule or attachment thereto and any amendment thereof.

any and all taxes and similar charges, duties, levies or other assessments of any kind, including, but not limited to, income, estimated, business, occupation, corporate, gross receipts, transfer, stamp, employment, occupancy, license, severance, capital, impact fee, production, ad valorem, excise, property, sales, use, turnover, value added and franchise taxes, deductions, withholdings and custom duties, imposed by any Governmental Entity, including interest, penalties, and additions to tax imposed with respect thereto.

all or substantially all of the fair market value of such assets or that generated all or substantially all of the Company’s and its Subsidiaries’ net revenue or earnings before interest, Taxes, depreciation and amortization for the preceding twelve (12) months

all or substantially all of the fair market value of such assets or that generated all or substantially all of Parent’s and its Subsidiaries’ net revenue or earnings before interest, Taxes, depreciation and amortization for the preceding twelve (12) months
